title: LINE Conversation History Retrieval for Personal Memory RAG: Evaluating Search Representations and Hybrid Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2608.27809v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As an initial step toward personal memory retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for large language models (LLMs), this study presents a retrieval-only case study over one user's LINE conversation history. We segmented 358,896 messages into 22,329 temporally coherent chunks and constructed three search representations: raw_text, a generated summary, and embedding_text, which combines a summary with a raw-text excerpt and other fixed text. We compared BM25, dense vector retrieval, and linear hybrid retrieval on 100 evaluation questions verified by a single annotator. Among individual retrievers, embedding_text_bm25 achieved the highest point estimate, with Recall@5 of 0.584. We then explored six retriever pairings and 21 weights, for 126 configurations on the same evaluation set. The selected combination of embedding_text_bm25 and embedding_text_vector at beta = 0.45 achieved Recall@5 = 0.697, MRR@5 = 0.595, and nDCG@5 = 0.575. Its Recall@5

translated_title: 面向个人记忆RAG的LINE对话历史检索：搜索表示与混合检索方法的评估
translated_abstract: 作为迈向面向大语言模型（LLM）的个人记忆检索增强生成（RAG）的第一步，本研究针对单一用户的LINE对话历史开展了一项仅检索环节的案例研究。我们将358,896条消息分割为22,329个时间上连贯的片段，并构建了三种搜索表示：raw_text（原始文本）、生成的摘要，以及embedding_text（将摘要与原始文本摘录及其他固定文本组合而成）。我们在由单一标注者验证的100个评估问题上，比较了BM25、稠密向量检索和线性混合检索的效果。在单个检索器中，embedding_text_bm25取得了最高的点估计，Recall@5达到0.584。随后，我们在同一评估集上探索了六种检索器配对和21种权重，共126种配置。最终选定的embedding_text_bm25与embedding_text_vector的组合（beta = 0.45）实现了Recall@5 = 0.697、MRR@5 = 0.595和nDCG@5 = 0.575。
tldr: 本研究基于单一用户的LINE对话历史构建个人记忆检索系统，通过对比多种搜索表示与检索方法，发现embedding_text表示下BM25与稠密向量的线性混合检索（beta=0.45）能显著提升检索性能，将Recall@5从0.584提高至0.697。
en_tdlr: This study builds a retrieval-only personal memory system over one user's LINE conversation history, demonstrating that linear hybrid retrieval combining BM25 and dense vectors on the embedding_text representation (beta=0.45) substantially improves retrieval performance, raising Recall@5 from 0.584 to 0.697.
